title: Online payment adapter choices
decision: A table online_payment and three cross-tenant lookup functions beyond the approved schema; the owner makes an order first and the provider is given its identifier; one provider transaction per order and a cancelled order is not paid again; one Click endpoint for prepare and complete; a performed Payme transaction cannot be cancelled through Payme; a suspended shop cannot start paying, and money taken for a shop suspended meanwhile moves the paid-through date without lifting the suspension; disabled is answered with HTTP 503; a setting QD_CLICK_MERCHANT_ID was added
context: Decided by an agent during the autonomous build under DEC-020; implemented and awaiting the founder's review
chosen_option: Choices as listed in pull request 44
rationale: ADR-019 asks for adapters built and off and the specification names two endpoints; neither says how an order is identified or what a provider may undo
